messages:
Marta Alvarez: Heads-up — the API ref example for POST /v1/translate currently shows \"documents\" as an object. The implementation actually accepts an array and accepts null for streaming fallback. I opened a tiny PR to correct examples and add an explicit nullable-array schema. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4523
Jon Patel: Thanks — is it just the example or also the OpenAPI schema?
Marta Alvarez: Both. Example is wrong in the HTML pages and the YAML still had documents: object in one place (copy-paste error). We should update the OpenAPI requestBody schema to documents: { type: array, items: { type: string }, nullable: true } and sync the JS/Curl snippets.
Carla Nguyen: Can you paste a suggested curl + JS snippet? I'll pick that up in the docs build. Also we should call out behavior: documents=null => server interprets as streaming input (legacy), documents=[] => no input.
Jon Patel: Sure — quick snippets below, feel free to tweak:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/translate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"documents":["first doc","second doc"],"target_lang":"fr"}'

// JS
const res = await client.post('/v1/translate', { documents: ["first doc", "second doc"], target_lang: 'fr' });
console.log(await res.json());

Marta Alvarez: Perfect. Also add a short migration note under "API compatibility": older SDKs (<0.3.0) accepted a single string for documents automatically; modern SDKs require array or null. Recommend code sample for wrapping single string into [str].
Ben Foster: I'll update the OpenAPI YAML and push a fix for the HTML example in the docs site. I'll include the migration blurb and link to the SDK compatibility note. Planning to push within the hour.
docs-bot: Automated check — new PR 4523 created, link: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4523 :white_check_mark:
Marta Alvarez: Awesome, can you also update the embedding example under /v1/embeddings? It has similar copy-paste issue where one example shows object.
Ben Foster: Good catch — will sweep both endpoints.
Carla Nguyen: I'll review the PR once it's up. If you need me to re-run the docs build locally, ping me. :thumbsup:
Jon Patel: One more tiny thing — update the example response shape in the API ref to include tokens_used (we added it last month). Might be another copy-paste miss.
Marta Alvarez: Added to PR checklist. Thanks everyone — will mark this thread resolved once merged. :white_check_mark:
